scientific_integrity: Complete symbolic case proof and independent finite implementations are provided. Finite checks are not presented as proofs of the infinite-family theorem. Prior period-two and modular bounds are acknowledged; external independent audit is not performed.
scientific_limitations: Graph restricted to two cliques of sizes at least three linked by one bridge.
Exact individual fixed-point basin counts and exact transient-time population distribution are not claimed.
Unindexed equivalent historical barbell-majority work cannot be ruled out; the 1980 three-page original was not read in full.
title: Parity-locked majority oscillations and sharp settlement on bridge barbells
